# Combobox

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:combobox` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A free-text field with a filtered suggestion list that can also create a new value.

## When to use

Let people pick an existing value or create a new one by typing (tags, labels, recipients), with the themed field chrome, the ARIA combobox pattern, and a touch-safe font size, without a native datalist or app CSS.

- People type to find an existing value among many, or create a new one (tags, labels, recipients).

**Not when:**

- Do not use when only existing values are allowed and nothing needs typing; use Select.
- Do not use for free text plus removable filter tokens in one editor; use SearchField.
- Do not style a native input with a datalist from app CSS.

**Alternatives:**

- [Select](./select.md) (nearest) — Use Select when only existing values are allowed.
- [SearchField](./search-field.md) (nearest) — Use SearchField for search text with removable filter tokens.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/combobox` — exports `Combobox`, `wireComboboxes`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/combobox` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/combobox.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireComboboxes` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-comboboxes` (required).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/combobox`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuicombobox) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- with create
- suggestions only (createLabel={false})
- hint
- disabled

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the suggestions and the committed values; normalizing and validating created values; clearing the field after a commit.

**Wiring:** `wireComboboxes` is required.

- Filters suggestions, moves the active option, and reports commits; without it the list never opens.

**Wiring-owned state attributes** — never render, remove, or branch on these as app state:

- `data-value` on `the create option (kui-combobox__option[data-create])` (`wireComboboxes`): The typed text the create option would commit; rewritten as the person types.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Label and hint sit on the value's text column (1px border + 8px padding); the 44px field matches a themed wa-input.

## Accessibility

- Native input with role=combobox, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-activedescendant; options are role=option in a listbox. The visible label is a real label; the hint is aria-describedby.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-combobox`, `kui-combobox__label`, `kui-combobox__hint`, `kui-combobox__control`, `kui-combobox__input`, `kui-combobox__listbox`, `kui-combobox__option`.

Never put `kui-combobox`, `kui-combobox__label`, `kui-combobox__hint`, `kui-combobox__control`, `kui-combobox__input`, `kui-combobox__listbox`, `kui-combobox__option` on an element you write; render `Combobox` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-combobox-z-index`, `--kui-color-neutral-on-quiet`, `--kui-color-text-quiet`, `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-text`, `--kui-color-surface`, `--kui-color-surface-raised`, `--kui-color-text-link`, `--kui-color-brand-fill-quiet`, `--kui-font-xs`, `--kui-font-s`, `--kui-layout-item-padding`, `--kui-layout-rounded-radius`, `--kui-shadow-l`, `--kui-space-2xs`, `--kui-space-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
